title: APPEAL/2/2025 — V S BHANDARI COLD HOUSE vs. CANARA BANK
text:
Court of the Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
Item No. 13
Case No. APPEAL/2/2025 IN OA/39/2013
V S BHANDARI COLD HOUSE Vs CANARA BANK
Date: 06.02.2025.
Proceedings through hybrid mode
Present:
Shri Akarsh Mathur, Counsel for the Applicant
Shri Rajkumar, Counsel for the Respondent Bank/FI
In this matter, appellant is the main borrower and failed comply with
the pre deposit. Ld. Counsel for the appellant seeks one week time to
comply with pre-deposit.
Let the matter be re-notified on 24.02.2025.
Registry should not registered and place any appeal before the
Tribunal without compliance of the mandatory provisions.
(Vimal Gupta)
Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
*
